serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: Woah, that’s some really exclusive items you bought recently. You really are spoiling your girl.
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
Lady Annalie: I’m almost getting jealous~ I wish I got such a present from someone~
#Annalie.Face.normal
You: Isn’t this your shop? Everything here is yours anyway.
Lady Annalie: There is a difference between buying something yourself and getting it from someone.
#Annalie.Face.sad
Lady Annalie: Geez, men these days are not even one bit romantic! Trully, such a cruel time for women…
You: Ouch, that’s pretty harsh…
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: I guess you are at least putting some effort into it. Buying expensive stuff and such, but you better step up your game! You can’t take your girlfriend’s loyalty for granted.
You: Alright, alright. I will try. 
Lady Annalie: You better do! 
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
Lady Annalie: Same goes for your girlfriend. Girls love~ hot guys with money. {{wi}}And by the money you spend I can tell you got one of these things.
#Annalie.Face.normal
You: Thanks. I guess. {{wi}}Although I think I should be insulted rather than being grateful.
#Annalie.Face.eyeClosed
Lady Annalie: Buahahaha, don’t take everything so personally! I’m joking, joking! Your face is…{{wi}} uh…{{wi}} very symmetrical!
#Annalie.Face.normal
You: That’s the best thing you could come up with?!
Lady Annalie: Ah, such a pain! Thank you for your purchase and see you later!
You: Eh?! Wait!
Lady Annalie: Bye~ Bye~
